blocks.html: Where FEMA FIRMs 360497 indicates that a structure or tax lot is within a delineated special flood hazard area, but the pre-FIRM ground elevations adjacent to the structure or throughout the tax lot are at or above the base flood elevation, the commissioner shall deem such structure or tax lot as being within the special flood hazard area and shall not approve plans except in compliance with this appendix, unless a letter of map amendment (LOMA) is issued by FEMA removing such structure or tax lot from the special flood hazard area.
